review_notes: I read the whole file. The candidates were the `FundamentalGroupoid` wrapper structure with `equiv`, the `toTop`/`fromTop`/`toPath`/`fromPath` abbreviations, and the reparametrisation auxiliaries and homotopies. The wrapper is the standard way to put a category structure on the points of a space, and it is deliberate. The abbreviations are documented typechecker helpers. The reparametrisation auxiliaries feed `Path.reparam` and `Homotopy.reparam`, so they reuse existing Mathlib machinery. The simplicial-set fundamental groupoid is a different construction of a related object. I found no independent Mathlib declaration that this file duplicates in a way that costs anything, so I abstain.
